thought: This scene requires establishing the village setting with two main characters in action. Given it's a 5-second medium shot with character movement (Ge Zhenlin pouring water, Ma Baoyu running up and patting shoulder), I'll create 3 keyframes: (1) Opening - Ge Zhenlin pouring water, Ma Baoyu approaching in background; (2) Mid-action - Ma Baoyu closer, reaching out; (3) Final - Hand on shoulder moment. First keyframe uses Ref workflow to establish characters and setting with reference images, subsequent frames use Modify to maintain consistency.

Foreground left: man with robust build (Ge Zhenlin) standing beside large ceramic water jar, holding wooden shoulder pole with water buckets, mid-action of pouring water into jar, body angled toward jar. Background right: second man (Ma Baoyu) running toward foreground, smaller in perspective, dynamic running pose with forward lean. Setting: simple earthen house wall with wooden door frame visible on left side, dirt ground. Evening time. Camera at eye level, static. Rule of thirds composition with water jar on left third, running figure approaching from right background. Clear spatial relationship showing depth - foreground action with background movement.
